question: what it costs to run the MPC over the same field the commitments use
why: A value committed as a Pedersen commitment on ed25519 cannot be checked inside an MPC that works over a different prime, so today a node that inputs something other than what it was dealt is detected and attributed afterwards rather than prevented. Matching the MPC field to the curve's scalar order turns that binding into a distributed exponentiation: the nodes publish g^(share) and Lagrange-combine to g^v without opening v, and g^v is checked against the commitment. The question is the price.

prediction.bytes: about 2x, field elements 16 B to 32 B

result.note: Rounds were predicted unchanged and doubled. Bytes were predicted at about 2x and came in at 13x, so the prediction was roughly seven times too cheap. Wall clock is 2.06x at 15 ms and 2.50x at 0 ms --- the byte increase does not show up as time in proportion, because what the matched field costs is round count and arithmetic width rather than transfer. Both arms verified against the cleartext answer.
result.caveat: the seven parties share one machine and the delay is a loopback proxy, so bandwidth is not modelled. 277 MB of global traffic per quote is about 40 MB per node, which a gigabit link absorbs in a third of a second and a hundred-megabit link does not. On a real wide area link the 15 ms figure is a lower bound.

improvements.question: 277 MB a quote is not deployable. What brings it down?

findings.edabits: Predicted a large reduction, because edaBits make comparison cost scale with the value width rather than the field width. Measured the opposite by two orders of magnitude: 2,920 MB on the default field and 6,257 MB on the matched one. edaBits are a preprocessing technique and this harness measures a single phase, so their generation cost lands in the run with no offline phase to hide in. That is the item DEPLOYMENT.md already listed as the largest unmeasured unknown; this measures the wrong phase for it rather than showing edaBits are bad.
findings.existing_levers: `audit_gates` moves the expiry and active checks to the registration-time policy audit instead of paying for the same fact twice. `public_maker_assets` makes each maker's served market public business information, so the asset gate becomes a public index into a secret one-hot vector and costs no communication. Together: 277.3 MB to 137.3 MB, rounds 129 to 107, wall 7.39 s to 5.63 s. Against the default field that is 14.3x to 7.1x of traffic and 2.04x to 1.55x of clock. The second lever is not free --- it publishes which markets each maker serves.
findings.predicted_150_to_190_mb: measured 137.3 MB, slightly better than predicted

proposal_not_implemented.name: random linear combination input check, in the existing field
proposal_not_implemented.observation: Binding the *dealt* shares to a commitment never needed a matched field: the shares sum over the integers, so g^v = prod g^(v_i) in any group. What needs matching is binding what MP-SPDZ ingested. That can be done another way.
proposal_not_implemented.mechanism: The dealer already publishes a commitment per input. Derive public challenge coefficients by Fiat-Shamir over those commitments once the inputs are fixed, have the circuit compute s = sum c_j v_j + r for a committed mask r, and open s. Check g^s against the homomorphic combination of the commitments. A node that substitutes an input shifts s by sum c_j e_j, which is nonzero except with probability about 2^-40 over the challenge.
proposal_not_implemented.why_the_fields_do_not_clash: with 166 inputs of 31 bits and 40-bit challenges the sum is at most 79 bits, which reduces in neither the 127-bit MPC prime nor the 252-bit curve scalar field, so it is the same integer on both sides and the check is exact
proposal_not_implemented.why_the_mask: without it each quote opens one linear equation in the policy, and enough quotes with fresh challenges solve for it. The masking machinery already exists --- the answer is already opened under a trader-supplied mask.
proposal_not_implemented.predicted_cost: public coefficient times secret is local, so no communication; one extra opening is one round. Rounds +1, traffic plus one field element --- that is, the default field's 19.4 MB essentially unchanged.
proposal_not_implemented.status: reasoned and checked arithmetically, not implemented and not measured
